  • Nurul H.

    “This body wash has made my evening shower the best part of my day. It lathers nicely, smells like fresh serai, and my skin feels soft with no tight feeling afterwards. Love that it’s gentle enough for my kids too. Definitely restocking!”

    Serai Body Wash

    View product

  • Jason L.

    “This hair serum finally sorted out my frizz in this humidity. It’s light, not oily, and gives a nice shine even after a full day under my motorbike helmet. I’ve noticed fewer split ends after a few weeks. It’s now part of my daily routine.”

    Bunga Raya Hair Serum

    View product

    Teh Hijau Eye Repair
